whole_map_selection.program_1: The exact market-state router native path is economically consumed and closed; adjacent model, label, percentile, feature, hold, component, risk or volume rescue is prohibited inside Optimization.
whole_map_selection.program_2: No new independent external-market or scheduled-event evidence is ready.
whole_map_selection.program_3: No new dense order/session timing field is ready.
whole_map_selection.program_4: Existing hold, stop, realization, peer-exit and drawdown-management families are closed without a new independent current clue.
whole_map_selection.program_5: Static composition, capital ladder, aggregate risk, component state and reserve families are closed without a new independent current clue.
whole_map_selection.program_7: The complete router candidate creates a new attributable label-versus-shared-account-contribution mismatch with zero engineering fault.
whole_map_selection.selection_reason: Program 7 has the sole current complete and non-speculative information question. The unit diagnoses one fixed bundle and does not continue the Program 1 router family inside Optimization.

router_decisions.economic_origin: one complete valid native Optimization selection

fixed_match.feature_check: absolute anchor entry_feature minus router feature <= 1e-9 * max(1, absolute anchor entry_feature)

variants.rank: exact rank recorded by the native fixed-0.01 virtual-net router
variants.role: diagnose the consumed native router; cannot retain another copy of the already failed candidate

variants.label: anchor stressed_net_usd divided by entry planned_risk_usd
variants.label_availability: only after the matched anchor lifecycle closes
variants.fit_information: only matched anchor lifecycles closed before the current quarter
variants.rank: component-relative percentile among the current fit's training predictions

fixed_metric_conventions.rank_target: matched anchor stressed_net_usd divided by entry planned_risk_usd
fixed_metric_conventions.bottom_quartile_nonpositive_epoch: an epoch counts only when it has at least one bottom-quartile row and its summed stressed_net_usd is <= 0
fixed_metric_conventions.floating_gate_comparison: direct comparison to the frozen decimal boundary without rounding

stop_rules: Run one formal source-free analysis process after the snapshot and script are frozen.
If input or match integrity fails, correct engineering without an economic verdict and rerun the unchanged contract.
If any prospective account-R gate fails on complete valid numbers, retain no seed and close both variants.
Do not add another label, threshold, bin, component, epoch, feature, estimator or in-family rescue.
Return to a whole-map comparison after closure.
